notes.title: EONA will be present at Gamescom 2025!
notes.content: [h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45700900/ff7e5044067e1a1c8ef49c3968017d73c057fadd.jpg"][/img][/h2][h2]SUPER AC is proud to announce its presence at Gamescom in Cologne, Germany, this year, from August 20th to 24th, Hall 10.1, Booth B.091. [/h2][p][/p][p]At our booth, visitors will be able to try out: [/p][list][*][p][b]PROHIBEAST[/b], [/p][/*][*][p][b]EONA[/b], [/p][/*][*][p][b]CINESCAPE VR[/b], [/p][/*][*][p]and [b]SKY LEGENDS, an aeropostal epic[/b]. [/p][/*][/list][p]Come to meet the development teams and have a great time with us.[/p][p]We look forward to see you there. [/p][p][/p][p]PS: Free goodies for everyone who finishes the demo![/p][p][b][i]THE SUPER AC TEAM[/i][/b][/p]
